name: fo-individual-income-tax
description: Prepare 2026 Faroese personal-tax working papers for employees, sole traders and investors. Establish residence, separate A-income from B-income and investment income, reconcile business expenses and pension deductions, and compute national and municipal tax, family credits and the statutory income-tax ceiling. Check the separate capital-income calculation, housing-interest support, rental election, preliminary payments and annual settlement. Use for Faroese personal income tax, self-employed profit, child tax credits, private investments, foreign work and individual tax returns. Shipping, part-year credits, treaty relief, benefits and specified implementation questions require additional work identified in Sources. This is tier-2 material accepted for partial draft publication after independent AI review; professional attestation remains pending.
